## File: facebookresearch_multimodal/examples/mugen/generation/text_video_gpt.py

```
['build a text-to-video GPT model with configurable sequence lengths and pretrained weights', 'build a text-to-video GPT model using pretrained MUGEN weights for L32 sequence length', 'create a TextTokenizer that encodes sentences to padded token IDs with unique padding', 'encode a list of sentences into token IDs with unique padding on a device', 'decode token IDs back into human-readable sentences using the TextTokenizer', 'build a MUGEN Video VQVAE model for video tokenization with default encoder and decoder parameters', 'build a pretrained MUGEN Video VQVAE model using the mugen_L32 checkpoint key', 'build a frozen pretrained MUGEN Video VQVAE model with gradient removal for inference', 'review the video_vqvae_mugen function to understand encoder strides, decoder strides, and codebook parameters', 'summarize the MUGEN_PRETRAINED_MAPPING dict that maps model keys like mugen_L32 to PyTorch model URLs']
```
